lines: 还没等他从那极其剧烈的剧痛与五脏六腑移位的眩晕中缓过神来。
一阵极其刺骨的寒意，瞬间攀上了他的脖颈。
云辛杰艰难地睁开眼睛，赫然发现，裴苏不知何时已经犹如鬼魅般站在了他的面前。那柄散发着极致森寒的“天仙剑”已经出鞘，冰冷且锋锐的剑刃，正死死地压在他的脖颈上，甚至已经切开了一丝表皮，渗出了一缕刺眼的鲜血。
只要裴苏的手指再微微用力半分，他的脑袋便会立刻滚落剑池。
在绝对的实力碾压与真切的死亡阴影面前，云辛杰心头那刚刚膨胀起来的狂妄与不可一世，彻底粉碎掉。
那股刚刚被压下去的极致恐惧，又瞬间冻透了他的四肢百骸。
“扑通！”
云辛杰双膝一软，在这极其冰冷的剑刃下，他的眼泪和鼻涕混合着脸上的血污一起流了下来。
“姐姐！我错了！我真的错了！是我鬼迷心窍，是我不自量力！”
他求饶着，犹如一条摇尾乞怜的断脊之犬：“求求你别杀我！看在爹娘的份上，饶我一条狗命吧！我再也不敢了！我也是被逼的啊！”
云辛杰忽然想到了什么，连忙狡辩着：
“对！我是被逼的！这一切都是雪无痕和枯剑那个老东西逼我的！是他们将这些弟子抓来，强行逼迫我运转这邪术！姐姐，我从来没想过要伤害同门，更没想过要伤害你啊！你相信我，我是你的弟弟啊！”
“弟弟？”
裴苏看着跪在脚下痛哭流涕的云辛杰，嘴角缓缓勾起一抹嘲讽的冷笑，“云辛杰，时至今日，你竟然还蠢到以为，雪无痕是真心为了你好？”
云辛杰脸上挂着泪痕，呆呆地看着裴苏。
裴苏居高临下地俯视着他，眼神中透着一种怜悯与冷酷。
“你的确是他雪无痕的亲生儿子。但是，你动动你那愚蠢的脑子好好想想。雪无痕是不是对你好过头了，为何偏偏要将这等可怖的夺玄术传授给你？为何要冒着剑阁覆灭的风险，对你如此之好，甚至不惜亲自为你抓捕天骄作为养料？”
裴苏微微俯下身，声音犹如恶魔的低语，一字一顿地砸在云辛杰的耳畔：“真正的原因……是因为，他打从一开始，就是为了夺舍你。”
云辛杰的大脑瞬间一片空白，他整个人彻底愣住了，双目圆睁，眼球几乎要凸出眼眶。
“不……不可能！这绝对不可能！虎毒还不食子！他是我亲爹，他怎么可能会夺舍我？！”
云辛杰拼命地摇着头，浑身犹如筛糠般剧烈颤抖，他不敢相信，也不愿去相信这个极其惊悚的真相。
然而，裴苏并没有因为他的崩溃而停下：
“有什么不可能？雪无痕的修为早已停滞在瓶颈多年，寿元也在不断干涸。他极其渴望突破，所以，他早就在策划，将你的身躯当成了一个极其完美的器皿！”
裴苏用剑尖指了指那沸腾的剑池：
“他用这些天骄弟子的本源将你的肉身养到极致，甚至原本还计划着要夺取我的天赋，一并融入你的体内。等到你的躯壳彻底成熟的那一刻，他就会发动这夺玄术的最高奥义，夺舍你的肉身！”
看着云辛杰不断摆头的脑袋，裴苏眼里的怜悯之色越浓。
“一旦他成功将你的肉身夺去，飞雪岛这上百名天骄陨落的滔天惨案，自然也可以偷天换日，枯剑老人将其揽下，雪无痕不知所踪，这场惨案唯一的幸存者，便只有一个云辛杰，而谁也不会知道，他体内还藏着雪无痕的真灵。夺玄之术，上古十大奇术之一，一般人又如何想到？”
云辛杰跪在地上，瞪着眼睛，浑身发抖，依旧不敢置信。

Before he could recover from the extremely severe pain and the dizziness caused by the displacement of his internal organs.
An extremely biting chill instantly climbed up his neck.
Yun Xinjie opened his eyes with difficulty, and suddenly found that Pei Su had been standing in front of him like a ghost. The "Celestial Sword" that exuded extreme coldness had been unsheathed, and the cold and sharp blade was pressing hard on his neck. It had even cut a trace of his skin, and a ray of dazzling blood seeped out.
As long as Pei Su's fingers exert even a little more force, his head will immediately roll off the sword pool.
In the face of the absolute crushing strength and the real shadow of death, the arrogance and arrogance that had just grown in Yun Xinjie's heart were completely shattered.
The extreme fear that had just been suppressed instantly froze his limbs and bones.
"Plop!"
Yun Xinjie's knees weakened, and under the extremely cold blade, his tears and snot flowed down together with the blood on his face.
"Sister! I was wrong! I was really wrong! It was me who was obsessed with it, and it was me who overestimated my abilities!"
He begged for mercy, like a dog wagging its tail and begging for mercy: "Please don't kill me! For the sake of my parents, please spare my life! I don't dare to do it anymore! I was forced too!"
Yun Xinjie suddenly thought of something and quickly argued:
"Yes! I was forced! All this was forced on me by that old guy Xue Wuhen and Ku Jian! They caught these disciples and forced me to use this evil technique! Sister, I never thought about hurting my fellow disciples, let alone you! You believe me, I am your brother!"
"Brother?"
Pei Su looked at Yun Xinjie, who was kneeling at his feet and crying bitterly, and a sarcastic sneer slowly appeared at the corner of his mouth, "Yun Xinjie, to this day, you are still stupid enough to think that Xue Wuhen is really doing it for your own good?"
Yun Xinjie looked at Pei Su blankly with tears on his face.
Pei Su looked down at him condescendingly, with a kind of pity and coldness in his eyes.
"You are indeed his biological son, Xue Wuhen. But, use your stupid mind and think about it carefully. Is Xue Wuhen too kind to you? Why would he teach you such a terrifying mystery-stealing technique? Why would he risk the destruction of the sword pavilion and treat you so well that he would even personally capture the genius for you as nourishment?"
Pei Su leaned forward slightly, and his voice was like a devil's whisper, hitting Yun Xinjie's ears word by word: "The real reason... is because he has been trying to seize you from the very beginning."
"Boom!"
Yun Xinjie's mind went blank for a moment, and he was completely stunned. His eyes were wide open, and his eyeballs almost bulged out of their sockets.
"No...impossible! This is absolutely impossible! Tiger poison does not eat its seeds! He is my biological father, how could he take away my body?!"
Yun Xinjie shook his head desperately, his whole body shaking violently like chaff. He couldn't believe it, and he didn't want to believe this extremely shocking truth.
However, Peisu did not stop because of his collapse:
"Is there anything impossible? Xue Wuhen's cultivation has been stagnant for many years, and his longevity has been drying up. He is extremely eager to break through, so he has been planning to use your body as an extremely perfect vessel!"
Pei Su pointed at the boiling sword pool with the tip of his sword:
"He used the origins of these talented disciples to cultivate your physical body to the extreme. He even planned to seize my talent and integrate it into your body. When your body is completely mature, he will activate the highest secret of the mysterious art to seize your body!"
Looking at Yun Xinjie's head that kept shaking, the pity in Pei Su's eyes grew stronger.
"Once he succeeds in taking away your body, the heinous tragedy of the death of hundreds of geniuses on Feixue Island will naturally change the situation. Old Man Kujian took him in, and Xue Wuhen disappeared. The only survivor of this tragedy is Yun Xinjie, and no one knows that he still has the true spirit of Xue Wuhen hidden in his body. The art of seizing the mystery is one of the top ten miraculous arts in ancient times. How can ordinary people think of it?"
Yun Xinjie knelt on the ground, staring, trembling all over, still in disbelief.
